messages:
Ana (CSE): SkyBridge onboarding: after a canary deploy they hit a burst of 429s during initial worker warmup. Started ~10:01 UTC. Customer says it spikes right after their CI restarts many short-lived jobs.

skybridge-sre: Example: `2026-06-14T10:01:12Z POST /v1/embeddings 429 rate_limit tenant=skybridge job=ingest-42` then `2026-06-14T10:01:13Z ephemeral refresh ok id=tkn_sky44` then retries. Observed ~80 concurrent token fetches.

Ana (CSE): They're using node-sdk 2.1.0 in a serverless-ish fleet; each lambda-style function fetches ephemeral token on cold start and immediately calls embed(). No client splay.

Ben (SDK): Sounds like classic token refresh fanout + tight ephemeral grace. Quick client advice: per-process token cache or central token proxy, and add 50-250ms randomized init jitter. We can draft a micro-patch for 2.1.x to include a safe default.

Rox (Platform): Any infra changes recently? @deploy-bot can you confirm token-service config in last 48h?

 deploy-bot: 2026-06-14T03:40:02Z - token-service change: reduced ephemeral grace for opaque tokens from 9s -> 4s in canary (owner: infra/token-service).

ops-oncall: That reduction will expose init races. Ops can add a tenant-level grace override while they patch. I can apply a 30m override and a temporary burst slot.

skybridge-sre: Please do, this onboarding run is time-boxed. We'll also try to centralize token fetches behind a small sidecar.

Ben (SDK): I'll open PR SDK-834: "node-sdk: init jitter + process token cache" and cut a 2.1.1 patch. Example snippet to recommend to them: `const token = await tokenCache.get() // cache per container; expires ~45s;`

Ana (CSE): Applied workaround suggestion to SkyBridge and asked them to deploy a feature-flagged splay. They've confirmed they can flip it in their CI within 20m.

ops-oncall: Tenant override applied at 10:10 UTC. Observed concurrent preflight drop from ~80 -> ~6 within 2 minutes. Monitoring for 30m.

Ben (SDK): Patch PR opened and marked hotfix. Also adding docs to onboarding KB about serverless cold-start patterns and token caching.

skybridge-sre: After applying client splay + tenant override, init errors fell to ~1%. We'll roll SDK patch in next release. Thanks team.

Ana (CSE): I'll update account health to green after they confirm stability and schedule renewal outreach. Leaving this thread open until override is removed.

ops-oncall: Removing override at 10:40 UTC; no regressions observed. :white_check_mark:

Ana (CSE): Follow-up tasks: CSE KB draft + link to SDK issue + note on renewal check-in.
